duration.text: The Aquatic product processing and storage at Ocean University of China is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2847 USD/per year ￥ 20500 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2.Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3.Bachelor's degree diplomaGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4.Transcript of undergraduate school5.Two recommendation lettersFrom professor,associate professor or equivalents.6.CV( in Chinese or English)7.Study PlanIncluding study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief.

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be Non-citizens; 2. under the age of 35 3. university graduates with a bachelor's degree 4. English proficiency, which meets the requirements of the degree courses 5. be in good health; possess reliable financial support and custody.
